title: Continuity of a bilinear-form family evaluated along continuous data
statement: Let n, ℓ be natural numbers and L := L(R^n, R^ℓ). Let U ⊆ R^n be open and a : R^n → L(L, L(L, R)) (continuous bilinear forms on L) be such that x ↦ a(x)[P][Q] is continuous on U for all P, Q ∈ L. Let s : R^n → R^n, A, B : R^n → L and x₀ ∈ R^n with s(x₀) ∈ U and s, A, B continuous at x₀. Then x ↦ a(s(x))[A(x)][B(x)] is continuous at x₀.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (s : Rn n → Rn n) (A B : Rn n → Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (x₀ : Rn n), IsOpen U → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x P Q) U) → s x₀ ∈ U → ContinuousAt s x₀ → ContinuousAt A x₀ → ContinuousAt B x₀ → ContinuousAt (fun x => a (s x) (A x) (B x)) x₀
